rationale.coverholder_background:
Bass are a long-standing Lloyds coverholder with offices in both Florida and Alabama.

Ed Jackson, Joe Anderton, Bill Turgeon, Milan Stefanovic and Jason Clark and the persons responsible for the overall operation.

This is a core commercial occupancy book of Offices/ Warehouses and Condominiums. Risks will be located in Florida, Alabama and Mississippi.

Bass redirected its underwriting focus to target key characteristics which enabled them to create a focused small commercial product targeting Occupancy, Age Band and Valuation.

Bass' main markets are Ascot, Hiscox and Vave. They were seeking additional capacity due to having a large book with Vave.

rationale.uw_commentary:
2026:
- Expanded the occupancies a little to capture more of the book - retail, mercantile and social clubs are now added. These occupancies have good long term results
- Income was a little slow to begin with but is now on-track to c.$100k pm

2025:
•   This is a new Core Occupancy Commercial Property Binder.
•   EPI is expected to be around USD 2M as the business has been carved out of an existing book.
•   Distance to Coast restrictions apply (1 or 2 miles depending on the location)
•   Minimum 5%wind deductible.
•   Warehouses have been limited to 25% of the portfolio premium.
•   The policy will run until 31 December 2025 in order to become a 01/01 renewal.
•   This will be a Florida focused account (excluding Tri County) with some Alabama and Mississippi too
